TESTIMONY STATEMENT
Subject: Draft Environmental Impact Statement by USDI affecting Off-Road Vehicular uses on the public lands
On February 8, 1972, President Richard M. Nixon issued Executive Order #11644, which directed the U.S. Department of Interior to develop a unified interagency policy for the purpose of alleviating the growing use of off-road vehicles(ORV) on essentially defacto roadless public lands. In his executive order, the president apparently recognizes the massive debilitating effects of ORV use and that such use has become a major threat to our desert environment.
The Nevada Outdoor Recreation Association, Inc. has long expressed its grave concern over ORV activities on the public lands, and has attempted to develop meaningful solutions which would allow for reasonable ORV use on the public lands while restricting such use where there are fragile flora, wildlife, unique-natural, wilderness, archeological, historic, recreational and open space values.
